name: Duke Chapel Night
question: How are you feeling right now?
scene: an oil painting of a gothic chapel tower above still water, reflections on the water, visible brushstrokes
closing: Every visitor tonight has painted a little of this chapel. Yours is in there now.
consent: The camera follows your fingertip and the mic hears your answer. We don't save video or sound.

Your words aren't saved. We keep your path, your painting and a short mood label.
